THE EXPERIMENT DESIGN
From question to prediction.
A reproducible study organized around the six CRISP-DM phases.
Download CV audit ↓

      

      
What the scores mean
MAE
Average absolute error, in profit units.
RMSE
Emphasizes larger errors, also in profit units. Lower is better.
R²
Fit relative to a constant mean prediction. 1 is perfect; 0 matches that benchmark.
CV standard deviation
Variation across folds, not a confidence interval.
Read the results carefully
50 observations make this a useful teaching experiment, with limited evidence for broad business decisions.
The mean CV differences between methods are smaller than their fold variability. ElasticNetCV and LassoCV tie because the selected ElasticNet ratio is 1.0.
State uses one-hot encoding with California as the reference category. Model training and selection exclude all ten test rows.
